text:
maria: Heads-up: we have the Python/TS SDK GA cut window at 10:30 PT. Please avoid any dist-tag flips or manual republishing between 10:15-10:45. I will coordinate final signature checks.

josh: noted. I'm queuing the wheel builds now, ETA ~10:20. Will not flip dist tags until you give 👍.

deploy-bot: build-started: sdk-python@v2.3.0-wheel (job 4421)

maria: thanks @josh. once wheels are up I'll run gpg verify + checksum and then we can update dist-tag from `next` -> `latest`.

akshay: quick flag — the last publish had a signed-wheel mismatch on one platform (macosx). CI produced a different wheel signature. suggest we gate the dist-tag flip on checksum verification.

josh: ugh. I saw that earlier in canary. The mac wheel was rebuilt by a different runner. I can force-rebuild with hermetic container and re-upload.

ci-bot: artifact 4421/macosx-wheel: signature mismatch detected (expected 2a3f, actual 2b4e) — failing publish step.

maria: ok hold on flipping. @release-coordinator any objection to a short pause to republish the mac wheel hermetically and re-run verify?

release-coordinator: no objection. prefer a controlled republish vs flipping and rolling back later. timeline impact?

josh: republish + verify should be done by ~10:35 if runner queue stays clear. then I will post logs and the gpg verify output.

akshay: sounds good. Also recommend we keep `next` -> `latest` flip in the deploy-bot but gated behind a manual approval step so we don't auto-flip on a noisy success.

sophia: +1 for manual approval. We had one customer issue last month when a partial publish flipped tags.

maria: agreed. I'll add a short checklist in this thread: 1) all wheel builds present 2) checksums match across platforms 3) gpg sig verify 4) changelog updated + link 5) post-release smoke. Only once all pass we flip.

josh: republish done 10:29. logs: `upload succeeded`. running verify now...

ci-bot: verify-job 4421/verify: gpg: Signature made Wed Mar 20 10:30:01 2025 PDT — Good signature

josh: verify output pasted. checksums align across linux/macos/wheels.

maria: thumbs on status: +1 from me. @release-coordinator please approve dist-tag flip when ready.

release-coordinator: approved. go ahead.

deploy-bot: dist-tag-update: `next` -> `latest` for package `redwood-sdk` (v2.3.0) by josh at 10:33 PT

maria: flipping changelog link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/compare/v2.2.9...v2.3.0 — please confirm docs team has the release notes queued.

sophia: docs are staged; publishing scheduled for 10:40.

akshay: post-flip smoke: quick sanity checks on hosted API calls with new client. running now.

josh: sample install command for QA: `pip install redwood-sdk==2.3.0 --index-url https://pypi.internal.redwood`

maria: smoke looks green from my end. latency and basic calls OK. cc @support for watch.

support: watching. will escalate if any errors reported.

maria: thanks everyone. I'm going to file a short postmortem note in release docs describing the signed-wheel mismatch root cause and mitigation (hermetic builders + checksum gate).

josh: tl;dr: enable hermetic mac runner and add checksum gate — I'll open PRs for both.

maria: closing the window. If anyone sees anything odd ping here and we can rollback the dist-tag to `previous` and tag a hotfix. :thumbsup:
